errors.evidence: The horizontal axis displays a numerical scale from 0 to 40. It does not show percentage values. The data labels at the end of each bar show both the absolute number and the percentage, but these are not part of the axis itself.

The category label in the chart is 'RegiX среда за междурегистров обмен', not 'RegiX среда за междууредов обмен'. The word 'междурегистров' (inter-registry) was incorrectly transcribed as 'междууредов'.
